- A tan/white necrotic center
- A reddish-brown to purple halo
- A yellow chlorotic outer ring

This pattern — small oval spots with concentric rings (tan center, brown halo, yellow ring) — is characteristic of **Eyespot** disease. Now let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference eyespot image shows many small circular lesions with yellow halos — consistent with eyespot, though the test image shows a more advanced stage with clearer necrotic centers and red-brown borders. This concentric ring pattern (tan center → red-brown ring → yellow halo) on corn leaves is the hallmark of Eyespot.
